b89d0f3b0d.q: What are the prerequisites in warehouse management before implementing automation at Panaxis?
b89d0f3b0d.a: Before automating, companies must have tight control over their inventory and know exactly what is happening in their facility. Panaxis requires access to ERP system data and recommends assessing whether automation is even the right choice first. If a company lacks inventory discipline, uses paper-based processes, or hasn't implemented barcoding infrastructure, these should be addressed before automation, as automating an unknown manual process creates chaos.

8de9a9d874.q: How do AGV and AMR mobile robots differ in warehouse automation systems?
8de9a9d874.a: An AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) follows a predetermined path using magnetic inserts, strips, or wayfinding markers in the floor. An AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robot) maps and optimizes routes in real time and can adapt if it encounters obstructions. Although they have similar geometries, their internal navigation systems are quite different, with AMRs offering more flexibility.
